items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: When I was there there was only three guys... Nat Pierce, Chuck Anderson and me... And when I left it stayed the same, Ronnie Zito come in.

ctx.x: Who was the rhythm section with the Herman band with the first herd?

When I was there there was only three guys, and we were there forever. Nat Pierce, Chuck Anderson and me. They’re both dead now. Chuck just died a few months ago. But that’s all there was, three guys. We never changed. And when I left it stayed the same, Ronnie Zito come in. So they stayed the same then.
Did they call that the “second herd?”
